name: ulamu
description: ULAMU — Plateforme de santé numérique, Congo-Brazzaville. Monorepo : api (NestJS), mobile (React Native, patients), web (React + Vite, professionnels/structures/admin).

scripts.lint: pnpm -r lint && npm run lint --prefix apps/web && npm run lint --prefix apps/mobile
scripts.test: pnpm -r test && npm test --prefix apps/web && npm test --prefix apps/mobile
scripts.build: pnpm -r build && npm run build --prefix apps/web
